prewrittenContent.hook: Before the website, get this part right
prewrittenContent.body:
Slide 1: Before the website, get this part right
Slide 2: Know exactly what you do best. Every trade has a specialty inside the specialty — say what yours is.
Slide 3: Know who you're actually for. Emergency calls, planned installs, repeat maintenance — the pitch changes depending on which.
Slide 4: Know what makes a customer trust you on day one, before any history exists between you.
Slide 5: A website can't invent any of this. It can only show it clearly once you know what it is.
Slide 6: Get that part right first. The site is easy after. — Trevo

prewrittenContent.hook: The trade doesn't get enough credit for how much judgment it takes.
prewrittenContent.body:
The trade doesn't get enough credit for how much judgment it takes.

Every job is a little different. Every house has its own quirks. Knowing what you're looking at before you open a wall or a panel is its own kind of expertise, built over years, not taught in an afternoon.

That's the part marketing tends to skip past — the actual skill, in favor of generic claims that could apply to anyone.

We'd rather point at the work itself. That's the part worth being proud of.

— Trevo
